correctness.rationale: For crown K_{n,n}-M_n, n>=3, the exact local update at matched coordinate i uses the opposite shore count excluding its partner. Even n produces an involutive response on the central binomial layer and unanimous responses off it, giving T<=1; odd n has four weight classes L/M/P/H and update maps a&~b, a|~b at the two central levels. The submitted exhaustive case analysis partitions all first-entry times T<=3 by eventual period, with exact multinomial/Vandermonde simplification and the unique odd opposing-unanimity two-cycle. The displayed N_(T,p) sum to 4^n with correct small cases; independent literal 2n-vertex dynamics for n=3..7 reproduced all joint cells. The general proof, not those finite cases, establishes the formula for every stated n.
